title: Rhubarb Gelatin Salad
description: This easy rhubarb gelatin salad recipe is made with chopped fresh rhubarb, raspberry-flavored gelatin, and walnuts, and takes only 20 minutes to prep.
ingredients: 0.5 cup white sugar, or to taste
1 (3 ounce) package raspberry flavored Jell-O® mix

steps.text: Bring rhubarb, sugar, and 2 tablespoons water to a boil in a saucepan over medium heat; cook until rhubarb is mushy and forms a sauce, about 15 minutes. Reserve 1 cup sauce; set aside remaining sauce for another use.

Combine raspberry-flavored gelatin mix and reserved 1 cup hot rhubarb sauce in a bowl until gelatin is completely dissolved; stir in 1 cup cold water. Stir in apples and walnuts: pour into a serving bowl.
Refrigerate salad until set, 2 to 4 hours. Garnish salad with whipped topping or creamy salad dressing.
